anomalies.description: Police officers in riot gear are engaged in physical struggle with a group of civilians, involving pushing, grabbing, and use of batons; one officer appears to strike or press a baton against a person's head/shoulder area while others restrain individuals.

A violent confrontation between police in riot gear (helmets, shields, batons) and a group of civilians, including women, in close physical contact; officers appear to be using force (batons, pushing) against protesters who are resisting or being restrained.; A violent clash between riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields with 'ΑΣΤΥΝΟΜΙΑ POLICE' markings) and protesters wielding wooden batons with red fabric attachments; the confrontation involves repeated striking of shields, pushing, and use of force on both sides in a confined urban space.; Violent clash between riot police in helmets and shields and protesters wielding batons and banners; tear gas is deployed, causing smoke and chaos.

Police officers in riot gear are seen physically restraining and striking individuals—including at least two women wearing caps—who appear unable to effectively resist, consistent with abuse of vulnerable persons during crowd control.

A police officer in helmet and uniform is seen pressing a baton or similar object against the side of a civilian’s head/neck while the civilian appears restrained and unable to resist, consistent with abuse of a helpless individual during the scuffle.

Mutual physical combat: protesters repeatedly strike police shields with batons while officers push back and attempt to control or subdue individuals; visible contact includes baton impacts on shields and officers grabbing/containing protesters.

A protester appears subdued and pinned against a vehicle by multiple officers while being struck with batons; the individual is in a vulnerable position (bent over, head down) and unable to effectively defend themselves during this interval.
Direct physical combat: protesters swing wooden batons at police lines while officers push back with shields; visible contact and struggle in close quarters.

A protester appears subdued on the ground near a police vehicle while officers press forward with shields and batons; one officer appears to strike downward toward the prone individual amid tear gas.; A protester appears to be on the ground or crouched while police officers advance with batons and shields; one officer appears to strike downward toward the individual, who is not actively resisting at that moment.

Police in riot gear deploy tear gas and use batons against a crowd of protesting teachers; protesters are seen shielding themselves, holding banners, and engaging in close confrontation with police amid heavy smoke and water spray.
Close physical struggle between individuals: one person is seen being pushed or struck near the police vehicle while others intervene; visible contact and grappling occur amid smoke and chaos.

Police special forces in riot gear are actively deploying water cannons and appear to be engaging with protesters in a violent confrontation; visible smoke, debris, and aggressive postures indicate collective violent unrest.

Police officers are shown actively spraying a water cannon and wielding batons toward individuals who appear to be retreating or non-combatant (e.g., teachers per on-screen text), suggesting disproportionate force against vulnerable persons.
Police in riot gear deploy tear gas and water cannon against protesters; visible chaotic confrontation with smoke, projectiles, and defensive postures.
